d: Namaste, volvo just unveiled their EX90 full-size SUV in India. It will be their flagship offering in India, and that will also be followed by ES90's launch somewhere before October 12. While the prices of both ES90 and EX90 will be available from October 12, I got a good chance to have a look at the EX90 and drive it for a duration that I could film my impressions and reviews about it.
